title: Flash
summary: An overexposed white flash hides the cut from A to B.
signature: flash(a, b, p, { color, bloom, peak })

params.name: bloom
params.description: blur at the peak in px

notes: An overexposed white flash: A burns out, the cut happens at the peak, B comes back from the white.
At p = 0 only A shows, at p = 1 only B; keep B above A (z-index).
when: hiding a cut with an impact
a drop, a reveal, a shout
